plugin.name: Node.js
plugin.description: Node.js toolchains, npm / yarn / pnpm / bun, package.json scripts and dependencies
opt.args.info: Extra arguments passed to the script, split with shell rules. -- is added automatically for npm.
opt.packageDir.info: Workspace member directory relative to the module root. Leave empty for the module itself.
opt.packageManager.info: Detected from the packageManager field, lockfiles and the node_modules install record.
opt.runner.info: Running directly skips the npm/yarn/pnpm wrapper process, saving about 100 MB of memory; pre/post hooks and npm_* variables still apply. Choose the package manager if the script relies on its special behavior.
action.reinstall.confirm: node_modules will be deleted and dependencies reinstalled. Lockfiles are not changed. Continue?
setting.binaryMirrors.info: When the China mirror region is active, points packages that download extra binaries during install (node-sass, electron, sharp, puppeteer, playwright, sentry-cli and more) and node-gyp headers at mirrors. Variables you set yourself are kept.
view.deps.name: Package
deps.outdatedPackageJson: package.json dependencies changed since the last install
problem.packageJson.title: package.json cannot be parsed
problem.nodeConflict.title: Node version conflicts with dependencies
problem.nodeConflict.message: {0} pins Node {1}, but the dependencies need {2}.
problem.legacy.title: OpenSSL legacy provider required
problem.legacy.message: {0} is based on webpack 4 and fails with ERR_OSSL_EVP_UNSUPPORTED (0308010C) on Node {1}.
fix.useRequiredNode: Switch to the required Node version
fix.killPort: Kill the process using the port
fix.relaxedLockfile: Install from the lockfile loosely (lockfile untouched)
fix.relaxedLockfile.done: Later installs no longer require an exact lockfile match; the lockfile is still never written
fix.moreHeap: Raise the memory limit to 4 GB
fix.nodeSassVersion: Use a Node version node-sass supports
diag.node.openssl-legacy.title: OpenSSL 3 is incompatible with old webpack
diag.node.openssl-legacy.message: Node 17+ ships OpenSSL 3, which disables the md4 hash used by webpack 4 era tools. Enable the legacy provider or use Node 16.
diag.node.port-in-use.title: Port {1} is in use
diag.node.port-in-use.message: Another process is listening on port {1}.
diag.node.command-not-found.title: Command not found: {1}
diag.node.command-not-found.message: A command used by the script does not exist, usually because dependencies are missing or incomplete.
diag.node.module-not-found.title: Cannot find module {1}
diag.node.bin-permission.title: {1} is not executable
diag.node.bin-permission.message: node_modules was probably copied from another system. Reinstall dependencies.
diag.node.engine-yarn.title: Dependency requires Node {1}
diag.node.engine-yarn.message: Node {2} does not satisfy engines.node declared by a dependency.
diag.node.engine-npm.message: The current Node does not satisfy engines.node declared by a dependency.
diag.node.vite-requires-node.title: Vite needs a newer Node
diag.node.vite-requires-node.message: The current Node is older than this Vite version requires.
diag.node.crypto-hash.title: Node is too old
diag.node.crypto-hash.message: A dependency uses an API the current Node lacks. Vite 7 needs Node 20.19 or 22.12+.
diag.node.eresolve.title: Peer dependency conflict
diag.node.eresolve.message: The package manager cannot satisfy every peer dependency. Ignoring the conflict matches npm 6 behaviour and usually works.
diag.node.lockfile.title: Lockfile out of sync with package.json
diag.node.lockfile.message: package.json changed but the lockfile was not updated. Dependencies can still be installed loosely without writing the lockfile.
diag.node.heap-oom.title: Node ran out of memory
diag.node.heap-oom.message: The process exceeded the V8 heap limit.
diag.node.gyp.title: Native module build failed
diag.node.gyp.message: A dependency is compiled with node-gyp and Python or a C++ toolchain is missing, or it does not support this Node version.
diag.node.node-sass.title: node-sass does not support this Node
diag.node.node-sass.message: node-sass only ships binaries for specific Node versions. Switch to a supported Node and reinstall.
diag.node.enospc-watchers.title: File watcher limit reached
diag.node.enospc-watchers.message: Run sudo sysctl fs.inotify.max_user_watches=524288 to raise the limit, or switch to polling.
diag.node.corepack-keyid.title: corepack signature check failed
diag.node.corepack-keyid.message: The corepack bundled with this Node is too old to know the current npm signing keys.
diag.node.node-options-flag.title: NODE_OPTIONS contains {1}, unsupported by this Node
diag.node.node-options-flag.message: An option meant for newer Node is being used with an older Node.
install.title: Install dependencies
run.direct: Running the script command directly (no resident {0} process, saves memory)
run.nodeOptionsSanitized: Node {0} does not support --openssl-legacy-provider; removed from NODE_OPTIONS for this run
diag.node.yarn-network.title: Slow network while downloading dependencies
diag.node.yarn-network.message: yarn 1 downloads from the URLs recorded in yarn.lock and ignores the mirror. When they point at registry.npmjs.org this can be slow; check your proxy.
